project_title: The Karmic Genie Show — S01E01: Respect Your DUTY First. (Epic Movie Edition)
series_format: The 7D Way — Virtues & Divinity Theatrical Movie Series (White-Wall Portals + Active Two-Birds In-Scene Narrators)
target_platform: Google Flow Storyboard Suite (MCP + CDP Port 9225/9222)

@Me.canonical_look: Exact likeness of @Me (swept-back dark hair, salt-and-pepper stubble, warm expressive eyes) wearing his tailored ivory-white bandhgala suit.

Bala-Rishi.canonical_look: 4-year-old boy sage Bala-Rishi (top-knot bun, Urdhva Pundra tilak, Rudraksha mala, cream silk kurta & golden-bordered shawl).

Bala-Matha.canonical_look: Young divine girl sage Bala-Matha (vibhuti/kumkum on forehead, magenta-green silk pattu pavadai with golden zari border, fresh white jasmine garlands).

signature_cinematic_mechanics.two_birds_active_narrator_law: Narrator (@Me) + ONE Child ONLY (Bala-Rishi OR Bala-Matha) live physically inside each movie scene—walking, kneeling, or riding beside characters to narrate inner conscience.
signature_cinematic_mechanics.bullet_time_freeze_frame_walkthrough: [SCENE TIME-PAUSE] freezes raindrops, traffic horns, and moral crossroads in 3D bullet-time while @Me + 1 Child walk calmly through the frozen frame.
signature_cinematic_mechanics.white_wall_zoom_portal: Pure-white circular marble Karmic Genie Show studio wall acts as a seamless zoom-in/zoom-out cinema portal.

episode_1_storyboard_scenes.title: Day 1 vs. Day 2 Monsoon Scooter Accident (3D Bullet-Time Time-Pause)
episode_1_storyboard_scenes.setting: Rain-slicked dusk suburban bend in South India; frozen raindrops & amber brake-light reflections.
episode_1_storyboard_scenes.characters: Commuter driver Raghav, fallen scooter rider, Narrator @Me (ivory bandhgala) + 4yo Bala-Rishi.
episode_1_storyboard_scenes.two_birds_blocking: NARRATOR + 1 CHILD (Bala-Rishi): @Me and 4yo Bala-Rishi walk calmly through suspended raindrops beside the open sedan door and wounded scooter rider.
episode_1_storyboard_scenes.time_pause_mechanic: [SCENE TIME-PAUSE] freezes the monsoon drizzle right as Raghav considers driving away after causing the minor clip.
episode_1_storyboard_scenes.dialogue_anchor: Next evening—same minor accident. Except tonight, his car caused it, and nobody else is around.

episode_1_storyboard_scenes.title: 2:30 AM Sleepless Guilt & The Wife's Mirror ('You Should Have Helped Him!')
episode_1_storyboard_scenes.setting: Moonlit South Indian bedroom at 2:30 AM with warm amber bedside lamp.
episode_1_storyboard_scenes.characters: Sleepless Raghav, his wife Ananya, Narrator @Me + Bala-Matha.
episode_1_storyboard_scenes.two_birds_blocking: NARRATOR + 1 CHILD (Bala-Matha): @Me and Bala-Matha stand quietly in soft golden conscience light by the bedpost as Ananya speaks the piercing truth.
episode_1_storyboard_scenes.time_pause_mechanic: Intimate psychological stillness contrasting Day 1's effortless sleep with Day 2's burning guilt.
episode_1_storyboard_scenes.dialogue_anchor: Yesterday his wife said nothing. Tonight she cries, 'You should have helped him!' Why? Because helping became HIS DUTY!

episode_1_storyboard_scenes.title: White-Wall Zoom-Out to The Karmic Genie Show Circular Marble Stage
episode_1_storyboard_scenes.setting: Pure-white circular marble amphitheater with brushed-gold '1. Respect Your DUTY First.' inscription & dormant gold Genie lamp.

episode_1_storyboard_scenes.dialogue_anchor: True Duty is never an office contract. Duty is the sacred task whose neglect awakens guilt inside your Conscience!
